The successful candidate will analyze financial statements, prepare financial models and reports, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and provide insights to support informed business decisions. The role involves conducting financial research, identifying trends and variances, evaluating business opportunities, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve financial performance and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in finance and accounting, excellent analytical skills, and proficiency in financial analysis tools and ERP systems, preferably SAP. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Analysis and Reporting Analyze financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, to evaluate financial performance and identify trends. Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and presentations for internal stakeholders and management. Analyze financial data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify performance gaps, cost-saving opportunities, and potential revenue growth. Conduct financial research and interpret data to support business planning and strategic decision-making. Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of financial data and reports. 2. Budgeting and Forecasting Assist in preparing annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and financial projections. Collect, consolidate, and analyze financial data from various departments to support the budgeting process. Monitor actual financial performance against approved budgets and forecasts. Conduct variance analysis to identify discrepancies between actual results and planned targets and provide explanations for significant variances. Support the development of financial models to assess business performance and forecast future financial results. 3. Financial Modeling and Business Support Assist in developing financial models and conducting scenario analysis to support business planning and decision-making. Support the preparation of business cases and investment proposals by evaluating financial feasibility, return on investment (ROI), and associated risks. Conduct financial and economic research to identify market trends, business conditions, and potential growth opportunities. review_candidates.title: Associate Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description OrchidaTax is a leading global provider of tax software solutions with a strong focus on electronic invoicing and compliance automation. As the dedicated tax arm of OrchidaSoft, a technology pioneer since 1997, OrchidaTax serves more than 5,000 branches and over 350 tax solutions clients, including many multinational organizations. The company processes millions of e‑invoices daily, continuously updating its solutions to align with evolving tax regulations and technology trends. With roots in Saudi Arabia and Egypt, OrchidaTax is committed to becoming the foremost electronic invoicing provider across the Middle East. The organization emphasizes people, innovation, and customer satisfaction, offering a collaborative environment for professionals interested in tax technology and digital transformation. Job Summary We are looking for an Associate Project Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Nozha, supports the planning, execution, and successful delivery of client projects. The role involves coordinating with clients, internal teams, and technical stakeholders, tracking project progress, managing documentation, and ensuring that project activities are delivered according to agreed timelines and requirements. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining clear communication with all stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Support the planning, scheduling, execution, and monitoring of project activities and milestones. Coordinate communication between clients, internal teams, technical teams, and external stakeholders. Follow up on project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and action items to ensure timely completion. Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, timelines, meeting minutes, status reports, and other relevant records. Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to the Project Manager and relevant stakeholders. Identify potential delays, risks, issues, or dependencies and escalate them appropriately. Coordinate project onboarding activities, including document collection, requirements gathering, and access coordination. Support the preparation and tracking of project requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Assist in managing change requests, approvals, and updates to project documentation. Organize and participate in project meetings, prepare agendas and meeting minutes, and follow up on assigned action items. Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and client reviews. Support the Project Manager in ensuring projects follow established processes, standards, and methodologies. Maintain effective relationships with clients and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field . 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, operations, PMO, or a similar role. Basic to intermediate understanding of project management principles and methodologies . Experience working in a software, technology, IT, or client-facing environment is a strong plus. A-CPM or PMP Certificate is a plus. Familiarity with project management tools and systems is an advantage.
